connect.title: Connect a WhatsApp number
connect.line: Use the details from Meta's WhatsApp Business tools. The number is checked with Meta before it is connected.
connect.phoneNumberIdHint: A long number, not the phone number itself.
connect.wabaIdHint: If you give it, Wasla checks that the number belongs to this account.
connect.accessTokenHint: A system user token with WhatsApp permissions. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
connect.displayNameHint: So your team recognises the number, for example "Sales line".

guide.title: Where to find these details
guide.step1: Open Meta Business Suite and go to the WhatsApp Manager of the business that owns the number.
guide.step2: In WhatsApp Manager, under Phone numbers, select the number. Its Phone number ID and the WhatsApp Business Account ID are also shown in your Meta app's API Setup panel.
guide.step3: In Business settings, open System users, add a system user (or use an existing one), and with Assign assets give it full control of your app and of the WhatsApp Business Account.
guide.step4: Select the system user, choose Generate token, add the business_management, whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions, and copy the token here.
guide.why: Wasla uses the token to send and receive this number's messages. It is stored encrypted and is never shown again.

detail.limitValue: Messages to new customers per 24 hours
detail.limitShared: Shared with other numbers of the same business
detail.limitUnknown: Meta has not told us this number's limit yet.
detail.limitError: The messaging limit could not be loaded.
detail.verifyTitle: Check ownership with a new token
detail.verifyBody: Paste a current access token for this number. Wasla checks it with Meta and stores it encrypted.
detail.disableBody: While it is disabled, Wasla does not receive this number's messages and nothing is sent from it. Its slot is freed. You can enable it again later.
detail.releaseBody: Releasing gives the number up, so any workspace can connect it. It cannot be undone here: connecting it again means proving ownership with Meta again. Its conversations stay readable.
detail.releaseConfirm: Type the number's last four digits, <digits>digits</digits>, to confirm.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been released, or the address is wrong.

selection.title: Choose which connections stay
selection.body: Keep exactly {count, plural, one {# connection} other {# connections}}. The others are disabled, never deleted, and can be enabled again when a slot is free.
